sentences.text: The Chief Justice Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Sujit Narayan Prasad

---------
For the Petitioner : Mr. Shubham Kataruka, Advocate For the State: Mr. Yogesh Modi, AC to AAG-IA For the RMC: Mr. L.C.N. Shahdeo, Advocate ---------
12/Dated: 29.07.2025 1) Heard the learned counsel for the parties.

2) The respondent nos. 1 & 2 are directed to file the affidavit not only with regard to the implementations of the order passed by this Court from time to time but also file specific affidavit with regard to:-
i) Whether there is any violation of the provisions of the Jharkhand Bovine Animal Prohibition of Slaughter Act, 2005, anywhere within the state of Jharkhand.
ii) Whether within the municipal area, the requirement of slaughter house can be said to be a mandatory requirement and, if so, whether the petty food manufacturers can be permitted to slaughter.
iii) Whether any illegal slaughter houses/ operators having been informed to be operating within the State of Jharkhand.
iv) Whether the provisions of the Food Safety and Standards (Licensing and Registration of Food Businesses), Regulations 2011, are being strictly enforced in the State of Jharkhand.
